morgan: Morning async — quick SRE check-in (what I did / blockers / today)

morgan: What I did: tuned alert debounce for kv-evict alerts, rolled a small canary (canary-id: cny-81) to disable aggressive prefix-warmup; ran a 1h latency sweep against model-prod-1.
Blockers: seeing a ~12% bump in p95 for short requests (<=64 tokens) after the change. Not sure if it's batching config or kernel selection.
Today: dig traces, correlate with batching rollout, add a short runbook entry if it's a config issue. cc @raj @claire

raj: saw that p95 bump too. I pulled a flamegraph for cny-81 — looks like queuing time increased around the batching layer. Will share trace id shortly.
Can you paste the canary query you used for the sweep?

morgan: trace id: trace-20260316-09c3. Query I used: `curl -s "https://observability.redwood/prod/query?metric=latency.p95&model=model-prod-1&range=1h&tag=canary:cny-81" | jq .`
Small log excerpt from host-021:
```
2026-03-16T09:12:03Z host-021 inference: req=0x7f2a queue_wait_ms=14 exec_ms=2 kv_hit=false
2026-03-16T09:12:04Z host-021 inference: req=0x7f2b queue_wait_ms=120 exec_ms=3 kv_hit=true
2026-03-16T09:12:05Z host-021 inference: req=0x7f2c queue_wait_ms=18 exec_ms=2 kv_hit=false
```
Looks like intermittent queuing spikes.

claire: I can take a pass on routing + kernel-selection diffs from last night’s deploy. Pushed a diff to infra repo: https://git.redwood/infradev/changes/1223 — I'll check the commit that changed default batch window.
I can also add a short alert runbook entry under docs/runbooks/kv-evict.md — assigning to myself for the write-up.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0316-42 for elevated p95 on model-prod-1. Current status: monitoring. Pages triggered: 2, suppressed: 1. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0316-42

elaine: If it helps, I can re-run the workload with `--batch-window=5ms` vs `--batch-window=20ms` on a staging host to compare. I have a slot at 11:30 PT.

raj: good idea — thanks @elaine. If you can capture req-level timestamps and include `X-queue-wait-ms` header in traces that'd be ideal. I'll correlate with KV hit rate.

morgan: action items summary: 1) @claire — audit routing/kernel diff and add runbook entry (ETA EOD). 2) @elaine — run the two batch-window tests at 11:30 PT and post results (please include raw traces). 3) @raj — correlate trace-20260316-09c3 and the batch queuing metric, share hypothesis. 4) I'll open a small rollback-capable canary to test reverting the debounce change if we confirm regression.
Anyone want to pick up paging follow-ups if incident escalates? Otherwise I'll monitor till 12:30 PT. :eyes:

raj: I can cover paging follow-ups if it escalates. Will set a short watch. :thumbsup:

claire: noted, will update runbook and post PR link here when ready.

morgan: thanks all — will update incident with today's notes and link this thread. If you find anything blocking the rollback plan please ping me directly.
